## About
Bill Boydstun worked as a building inspector for Golden Rain Foundation in Rossmoor. That work gave him real insight into these homes and a lot of friends. He started Boydstun Construction with no game plan other than hard work, and he hired his son Jonathan as his first employee.
His business plan was simple: honesty, integrity, quality and client satisfaction. After Bill retired, Jonathan incorporated the company and keeps working by those same beliefs. We take pride in every job, no matter how big or small.
We're a full-service contractor, specializing in remodeling Rossmoor homes. From kitchen and bath remodels to crown molding, custom fireplace mantles, ceramic tile and painting, we'll work hard to finish your project in a timely manner and to your total satisfaction.

## Services
- Full Remodeling: From full demolition to bare studs, to relocating a kitchen or bathroom, or adding a new room. We can work from your architect's plans or refer you to one.
- Kitchen Remodeling: Full kitchen remodels with design layout, new cabinets, countertops, appliances and flooring, or refacing your existing cabinets with new drawers and door fronts. Granite, tile or formica countertops.
- Bathroom Remodeling: New showers, bathtubs, tub to shower conversions, custom tile showers, shower pans, toilets and vanities, using cultured marble or swanstone shower walls and vanity tops.
- Washer/Dryer Installations: Tired of hauling clothes to the Laundromat? We install the drain, water supply, electrical and venting, and can finish it with a custom washer/dryer cabinet.
- Custom Cabinetry & Fireplaces: Custom cabinets, wet bars, book cases and entertainment centers, plus crown moulding, baseboard, wainscoting, skylights and fireplace mantles we design and build ourselves.
- Doors, Floors, Ceramic Tile: New doors, flooring and ceramic tile work for any room in the house.
- Electrical, Plumbing, & Carpentry: Our employees are skilled in all aspects of electrical, plumbing and carpentry, and we usually do our own electrical and plumbing rather than subcontracting.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Call us to talk about your project and we'll set up an estimate.

Q: Can you work from my architect's plans?
A: Yes. We can work from your architect's plans, or refer you to an excellent architect if you don't have one yet.

Q: Do you bring in subcontractors for electrical and plumbing?
A: We usually do our own electrical and plumbing, rather than subcontracting.

Q: Do you handle permits?
A: One reviewer said we worked with the city of Walnut Creek on her bathroom remodel and passed all permits.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday through Friday, 7:00 AM to 3:30 PM. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
